authoring_contract.pair_rule: The two cases use the same identity, asset snapshot, shared messages, query, and style. Only delta_message changes.
authoring_contract.hash_rule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(value), with object property order preserved as authored.

measurement_contract.tokenizer_rule: Do not estimate model tokens in the authoring draft. Compute with the tested model/tokenizer or record provider usage at run time, and save the tokenizer/model identifier.
measurement_contract.comparison_rule: All variants use byte-identical provider-visible case content; only the injected prompt variant may differ.
